arguments.value: User reports intermittent Zoom instability in detached office on a network with two Netgear R7450 routers connected in a simple out-of-box setup. Main house devices are stable, but in the detached office Zoom occasionally warns of unstable network or disconnects/reconnects; one IP conflict warning occurred on the PC. Other traffic like YouTube, Netflix, Prime, and speed tests are consistently fine (about 450/450 Mbps, 2 ms ping). Issue started after upgrading both routers and switching ISP from Spectrum cable to Home Telcom fiber. User wants a brief support summary, possible tests to run, and best reconfiguration guidance if needed.
